requirement_vague: Password reset should reject new_password with 7 characters with a 422 validation error.

omissions.description: Missing POST /api/v1/reset-password/ endpoint to handle password reset requests.
omissions.reasoning: The code defines routes for login, signup, user management, item management, and authenticated password change at PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password, but there is no POST /api/v1/reset-password/ route at all.

omissions.description: No validation is implemented for reset-password requests to reject new_password values of exactly 7 characters with a 422 validation error.
omissions.reasoning: Although UpdatePassword.new_password is validated to require length 8-128, that model is only used by PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password. There is no request model or handler for a reset-password endpoint where token and new_password are validated before token checking.
